name: What needs to be done before beginning a kitchen refresh on a foreclosed home?

mainEntity.name: What needs to be done before beginning a kitchen refresh on a foreclosed home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before work starts, verify that water, gas, and electrical utilities are officially turned on and safely inspected. Foreclosed homes are often winterized with lines drained, or utilities may have been shut off for non-payment. Ensure that plumbing supply lines and shutoff valves actually hold pressure without leaking behind drywall. You should also take clear photos of existing damage, document missing appliances, and verify room measurements. Deciding on your ultimate exit strategy—whether the property is an immediate resale, a long-term rental, or your primary residence—helps your contractor recommend appropriate finish grades for countertops, flooring, and tile.
acceptedAnswer.description: Turn on and inspect utilities, check for active leaks, document missing fixtures, and clarify whether the home is intended for resale, rental, or personal use.
